_comment: NOT captured from a live run. Four live attempts (default sandbox, read-only session mode, CODEX_CONFIG approval_policy=untrusted, and a network+outside-cwd command) all auto-approved on this workstation's authenticated Codex profile, so no live session/request_permission was observed. This fixture is reconstructed field-for-field from ~/Projects/codex-acp src/CodexApprovalHandler.ts (buildCommandPermissionRequest/buildCommandOptions) and src/ApprovalOptionId.ts, which give the exact request shape and optionId strings codex-acp sends for a command-execution approval. Treat as schema-accurate, not wire-observed.
